headline: Parks and recreation projects updates, including Community Preservation Committee funding rounds and ongoing park improvements.
summary: The meeting will cover director's reports on budget, correspondence, and project updates for parks including Balch Playground, Holcroft Park Splashpad, and Gillis Park Pavilion. Commission members will also give reports on BG&T, the Community Preservation Committee, and the Open Space & Recreation Commission.
